rubrics.justification: It appropriately notes that no image was provided and bases morphology on the reported Gardner grade, correctly describing AA ICM/TE and the 4 vs 5 hatching inconsistency without fabricating unseen image details.
It comprehensively integrates age, tubal factor, prior live birth, BMI, AMH/FSH, endometrium, smoking, semen parameters, and ovarian response with embryo quality and prognosis.

The reasoning is logical and well structured, with prognosis tied mainly to age-related euploidy risk despite excellent morphology; only minor ambiguity exists in blending implantation and clinical pregnancy terminology.

Recommendations are largely consistent with Gardner grading, single embryo transfer principles, smoking cessation, hydrosalpinx evaluation, and standard IVF practice, though some probability ranges are program-dependent rather than guideline-based.

It gives clear practical next steps for the current transfer and contingency planning for future cycles, including SET, hydrosalpinx check, luteal support, nutrition review, smoking cessation, and when to consider PGT-A.
